<div class="prose-slot">
<p>My research focuses on viruses hidden in eukaryotic genomes, comparative viral genomics, and AI-assisted protein discovery. I enjoy turning large, heterogeneous biological datasets into reproducible workflows and evidence that can be inspected from more than one angle.</p>
<p>This site is a home for my research, publications, technical notes, and occasional observations from life beyond the computer.</p>
